artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a forest featuring intertwined figures and various animals. The intricate line work depicts two central figures, one giving an apple to the other, with a snake entwined around a tree nearby. There are also depictions of a badger and a goat at their feet, and the scene is filled with dense foliage and branches. The composition is carefully balanced with detailed textures in the bark of the trees and the fur of the animals. The strong contrast created by the black and white ink work adds depth and drama to the scene.

artworks.title: The Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel banishing two figures from a forest setting. The drawing depicts an angelic figure holding a sword, pointing it towards two human figures. The figures stand in front of a thick tree with textured bark and branching limbs. The angel is depicted with detailed wings and is wearing a tunic with elaborate patterns. The two human figures appear nude, with one holding or gesturing to another as they look backward. An apple is represented above, hanging from a branch. The illustration is created in a style resembling that of Albrecht Dürer, showing careful attention to linear detail and texture.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a room. One figure has large, feathered wings and is standing with one hand raised, facing a seated figure with flowing hair and hands together. Above the seated figure is a dove surrounded by rays of light. In the background, an architectural frame is visible. In the upper part of the image, a small scene shows a figure on a cloud with symbols. The scene is detailed with various lines and shading, resembling a woodcut or engraving technique, suggesting an indoor setting with potential divine significance.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to block): 12.8 x 9.8 cm (5 1/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The image shows a rustic structure with a wooden beam roof, from an interior perspective. Inside, a baby lies in a crib filled with straw, surrounded by figures. To the right, there are trees and a bright star shining. An angel is depicted in the background, apparently announcing the event to another figure outside. The drawing is in a woodcut style, with strong lines and contrasts, and detailed textures in the wooden beams, clothing, and foliage.

artworks.title: Christ Taking Leave from His Mother
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in various positions, with one central figure standing and the other three gathered around in sitting and kneeling positions. The central figure has long, wavy hair and a beard, with distinct facial features and a serene expression. They are dressed in a long robe and holding an object resembling a book or a scroll. The other figures include one with a covered head and two cloaked individuals. One of the cloaked figures is gesturing towards the central figure. The setting includes a wooden structure on the left, trees and a town in the background on the right, and a path leading into the countryside. A barren tree stands near the path, with additional small groups of figures visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to block): 12.7 x 9.8 cm (5 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure pointing and surrounded by a group of people with palm branches. The scene captures a detailed and intricate line drawing, showcasing a central figure with a halo amidst a crowd. The architectural elements in the background include arches and curved walls, with foliage adding a naturalistic touch. The drawing style suggests a narrative or historical representation with fine linework and attention to the expressions and gestures of the figures.

artworks.title: Christ Expelling the Moneylenders from the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene inside a building with various figures and architectural elements. The illustration shows a figure in flowing robes energetically raising an implement that resembles a whip or cord. Surrounding the central figure are several others, some appearing distressed or surprised. Architectural elements include a large column and arched opening. The artwork emphasizes dynamic movement and dramatic expressions.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: This print shows a group of twelve men sitting and standing around a round table. The central figure is a man with long hair and a beard, with radiant white lines extending outward from his head, pointing upwards and to either side. He raises one hand upwards, standing behind a person sitting at the table who appears to be sleeping. On either side of him are more standing men who appear to converse with each other, while four more men sit at the round table with their backs to us. The men have various expressions and hairstyles, and they all seem to have light skin and wear draping robes. On the table, there is a plate with what looks like meat, cups, and bread. The background is a simple room, the walls decorated with thin horizontal lines. A large jug is on the ground by the seated men, near the bottom right corner of the print.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Feet of the Disciples
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene where one figure washes the foot of another seated figure. The illustration has detailed line work showing the folds of clothing and expressions of the figures. The setting is a dimly lit interior room with a textured ceiling and a chandelier with candles. The composition includes numerous figures around the central scene, each with distinct facial features and hair styles. The focus on fabric and human form suggests a Renaissance-inspired emphasis on anatomy and realism.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with religious themes. The artwork displays a collection of individuals positioned in a landscape setting, surrounded by clouds and dynamic scenery. The central figure is depicted in a flowing robe, holding their hands in front of them. The scene features intricate detail in the folds of clothing and the textured landscape in the background. A figure holding a cross is visible in the top left corner. The style features detailed line work and shading typical of a woodcut print.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a detailed print depicting a group of people engaged in a dramatic encounter. The scene shows various people holding weapons and lanterns. In the front of the group, one person lays on the ground, kicking up at a person who is looming over them with a weapon. On the right, two people appear to be embracing while a soldier tries to pull them apart. The background includes trees and a sky textured with horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Christ before Annas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring numerous figures in a detailed, historical setting. The central focus is on a bearded person seated on a raised surface, surrounded by others holding spears. The composition includes dynamic gestures, medieval-style clothing, architectural elements like an archway and pillars in the background. The artist's technique emphasizes intricate line work and shading, resembling a classic woodcut.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored figures approaching an authoritative figure seated on a high platform. The image shows several armed individuals surrounding and gesturing towards a seated figure. The figure is distinguished by a large robe and ornate hat, sitting on a raised seat under a decorative canopy. In the background, there are buildings, including a tower. The drawing is detailed, emphasizing textures of garments and weapons, with a strong contrast between dark lines and a pale background.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dramatic scene. The drawing uses an intricate interplay of lines and hatching to create depth and texture. In the foreground, there are several figures engaged in a dynamic interaction. The central figure is playing a musical instrument. Surrounding figures are either listening intently or gesturing towards the central figure. The setting appears to be indoors with an arched doorway in the background. Shadows and light play an important role in the drawing, emphasizing the expressions and mood conveyed by the postures and gestures.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: The image is a detailed woodcut depicting several individuals in a historical setting. Five full-body figures and two partial figures are shown. In the foreground, a soldier in armor is holding a spear, facing away from the viewer. A dog is beside him. Other individuals in various clothing are around them, with one person seated on steps and another man with a beard and turban standing at the top of the steps, gesturing. Pillars frame the background, leading to an arched walkway and a detailed landscape of a medieval town. The woodcut is monochromatic, using line work and hatching for detail.

artworks.title: Christ before Herod
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring an elaborate throne and several figures engaged in conversation. The drawing displays a detailed room with rich textures and elaborate patterns, dominated by an intricately designed throne. On this throne sits a regal figure adorned with a crown, holding a long staff, and exuding a commanding presence. Surrounding this central figure are other characters, each distinctively rendered with attention to their attire. The scene captures dynamic interaction, with one figure gesturing as if communicating something significant to the one on the throne. The architectural elements, such columns and an archway, provide depth and context to the setting.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: This is a print showing a scene with a group of people gathered around a column in an architectural setting. The column is to the right of center, and a man is tied to it, facing the left, his arms wrapped around the column and bound together with rope. The man is nude except for a small cloth tied around his waist, and he has a beard and long, curling hair. Two men stand on either side of him, holding up long objects and raising them above the tied man. More people stand on the left, looking on. These onlookers wear tall turbans and long, flowing robes. Another long object similar to the others is on the ground near the bottom left corner. The background shows tall walls and curved ceilings, with an arch on the left showing the edge of a building and trees under a blank sky.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a columned interior. One person is kneeling in front of another seated figure, gesturing with a hand. Other standing individuals hold staffs or sticks. In the background, there are architectural elements like arches and fluted columns. The figures are intricately detailed, with expressive faces and dynamic poses conveying tension. The drawing has a monochromatic color scheme and uses intricate linework and shading techniques for texture and dimension.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a scene with a group of people gathered around a central figure wearing a crown of thorns. The central figure stands within an archway, bare-chested, in a resigned or pained stance. Surrounding the central figure are various individuals engaging in discourse or gestures. Three figures on the right are in conversation, facing the central scene, while another figure on the left also engages with the central figure. One person seated at the bottom holds a staff or pole and looks up towards the central figure. The composition utilizes shading and lines for texture and depth, emphasizing the emotional intensity of the scene. The background features architectural elements like arches and beams, setting a classical tone for the encounter.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.description: The image depicts an old architectural scene with a group of figures surrounding a centrally focused activity. Details in clothing, furniture, and architectural elements are showcased. The figures are engaged in a solemn activity, implicating a sense of narrative. The architectural setting has strong vertical columns and arches, creating a dramatic composition. Details like folds in garments, expressions and positions of the figures, and ornate decorations suggest fine craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This image depicts a group of individuals surrounding a central figure carrying a large object. The scene is detailed, with figures clad in historical robes and armor, amidst a tumultuous gathering. The background includes architectural elements like stone walls and buildings, hinting at a city setting. The grouping of figures, their expressions, and postures contribute to a chaotic composition. The drawing is intricately detailed with precise lines capturing textures and forms meticulously, typical of Renaissance period prints.

artworks.title: Saint Veronica between Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.description: Three figures with halos are depicted in close proximity, all in robes. The central figure is a woman holding a cloth displaying a man's face with a crown of thorns, flanked by two men with distinct facial hair. The woman and one of the men carry symbolic items. The figures are within an indoor setting with wooden textures in the background. An inscription dated 1510 is above the central figure and there is an artist mark at the bottom.

artworks.title: Christ Nailed to the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical and religious scene of a crucifixion. The scene features several figures in various poses surrounding a man being nailed to a cross, who lies in the foreground. The figures wear clothing typical of medieval or renaissance eras, and some appear to be soldiers with helmets and spears. In the background, more figures are engaged in different activities. The woodcut-style etching provides a high contrast black and white image, showcasing a dense composition filled with action and emotion. The artist has used strong lines and detailed shading to convey textures of the fabric, musculature, and the environment.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image shows a central figure on a cross, with a long, emaciated body and a crown of thorns on its head. There are two groups of figures on either side of the central figure. One group appears to mourn or pray, while the other carries banners, spears, or wears distinctively patterned clothing. The ground below includes a skull and a small rectangular object. The scene is detailed with strong cross-hatching providing depth to both the figures and their surroundings.
